text:
Milan approved the financial statements for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026 and returned to a net loss of €24m after two years of positive results.
The club held its shareholders’ meeting today and released a formal statement confirming the details.
They closed the 2025/26 fiscal year with revenue of €464.6m and a net loss of approximately €24m.
“Gerry Cardinale’s leadership, combined with RedBird’s long-term investment and operational expertise, has driven the Club’s progress and continues to shape its future, with sporting competitiveness remaining the key priority.
“The appointment of Massimo Calvelli as CEO reflects this direction. And the new stadium, whose design we will unveil today, demonstrates the value of this approach: a transformative investment for AC Milan, our fans, the city of Milan and Italian football.”
The press conference is being held today between Inter and Milan to present the final design for the new stadium that will be built next to the existing Stadio Giuseppe Meazza, eventually replacing it.
The two clubs came together to purchase the land in the San Siro area of the city in November 2025, but it was only recently given the all-clear after appeals to block the sale were rejected.
